topic: Why gold became a 'safe haven' asset

sources.claim: Gold generates no yield/dividend/interest; value proposition is lack of counterparty risk vs stocks/bonds
sources.source: Standard finance-education concept (SEC Investor.gov / Federal Reserve educational materials describe stocks/bonds as claims on issuers; gold's zero-yield, no-counterparty-risk framing is textbook-level, non-disputed mechanics)

sources.claim: In 1971 the US ended dollar convertibility to gold (the 'Nixon Shock')
sources.source: Widely-documented historical event, Federal Reserve History

disclaimer: Educational content only. Not financial advice.
